book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Poropet wei lei ma yo
Yesu la veil inyon me la e maxow beeng qes Nasaret, me e xe xel betiyeing eno la is e.
Lek bouk Sabat eno moxo la teyoxe xel eivek xomek qekueing ama me xel ngenong wei ngo e eno etek. Xel neil, “Tambiy tine qou qayeeng me kwa nimza ne nanghei inya, me mi wong lulvako ne nangya mema?
Beip inye se kamunda? Beip inye se Maria neu moux, Jems, Yosep, Yudas me Simon lind? Beip e liyeiw vex se toundei is xey?” Om xel yei e wo nol.
Yesu neil wou xel, “Eivek beyeeng valuvalu eno xel mi sanghoxe poropet lei. Ekom eivek e venaxow beeng qes, me eivek e liyeiyeiw senghoing me eivek emaxow beeng, eno inyon poropet wei lei ma yo.”
E se teyei bei bong lulvako nanghei inyon, qe liw mema lek xomaxoneing nuyuw wei vanei yo me wong xel wo nimzalek.
De etek en xel on se mi wongis. Yesu wong xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw la Woyom Yesu la ghavineeng me teyoxe xel eivek beyeeng nge me la nge.
Dekakom moxo taxe xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw on lam wou e, me wong xel mi la yuyuw de wong nikanzek wei tiyeing laweeng nilaxes o is wou xel.
De moxo peti xel bei, “Xam se qou lulti en sakwaing qe xam a qou patongeeng dom xam se qou belet, vaxak de malew eivek xam xe bak.
Xam a byex vaxalambes, dom xam se byex teimb nge lek mapu.
Gyeik ingwei xam ghe na eivek xomek ti eno xam a mi mendei inyon deka xam ghe na veil beyeeng nayak tiyon le.
De wangwei beyeeng on ti se qou xam, o na ngo xam, ond xam pepa vegyuveeng veil vaxamim gyeik xam a being na veil o, en xel boulek bei xel wo kwa yon nol wou xow.”
Xel la myayaing me neil xoulek bei xomaxoneing pekwi xow.
Xel di tiy memo ngenong la myayaing me di taw wel lek xomaxoneing ngenong wei vanei wong xel eno is, om xel wong xel wo nimzalek.
Xel qateiv Yoan Lipekeing kwa tip
King Herot ngo, en Yesu lei wei xel woulek eivek tembuing sapa. Xel valu di neil, “Yoan Lipekeing eno qandi lek veil meyeing, omek mi wong lulvako en nikanzek wei toundei eivek e yo.”
Xel valu neil embei, “E yon Eliya.” De valu neil embei, “E yon poropet, nambei poropet wei takwei qenang eno ti.”
Ekom gyeik Herot ngo tine, moxo neil, “Yoan, tambiy tiwei a qateiv e kwa tip me e mey, eno qandi lek veil meyeing!”
En myaxeeng eno Herot venaxow wong qayeeng nikanzek bei xel a zeimaxoun Yoan, me na tup e me na toung eivek xeitueing. E wong tine en nambei Herodias, wei li Pilip venei wei e ii yo.
En Yoan vena neil wou Herot, “Inye se la teyei lek qayeeng petieing bei wang dii lim venei.”
Om Herodias lalei wo vanei wou Yoan om embei nyeis e. Ekom vexo se teyei,

en nambei Herot yaleeng en Yoan me mi yei e teyei, en woulek bei tambiy on bombek me moux wei vambuing o. Gyeik Herot ngo Yoan, moxo etek niseikeing me wounalei ngenong. Ekom e lalei vind en embei ngo e.

De woyom Herodias yimexe sakwaing wei embei nyeis Yoan e mey yo. Om lek bouk wei Herot umbek lek eno moxo wong mata ngandoung wou e xe xel wei leitata me lei ngandoung wei xel vevek me xel wei mi la tax en xel moux wei Galili yo.

Gyeik Herodias neu vex lam lalei me aw, vex on wo Herot me xel wei di ya is e eno laleind wo nimza. King neil wou vexawo yon, “Wa teling ay en vatiyeiw wei wa laleim vind o, ond tyek am bong wou wang.”

De neil zonghek is vex on is qayeeng neing, “Vati wei wambei teling ay eno tyek a bong wou wang. De wangwei wa teling bei a dembu a xe tete lalei na yuw me na bong wou wang on tyek a dembu de na bong veweeng wou wang.”
Vexo la myayaing me teling wou ta, “Tyek a teling wou en vati?” Ta neil elox bei, “Yoan Lipekeing lukanzek.”
Lutika eno vexo lox daing me la lalei wou King me neil wou e: “Am bei wang bong Yoan Lipekeing lukanzek wou ay gweimbeeng kane lek dipekta.”
King moxo lalei wo maying ngandoung, en nambei ingwei neil zonghek is xel wei lam di ya is e yo, om embei se pesek lek vexawo yon.
Om wo daing me wong e xe vevek tiwei mi qateiv xel kwend eno is qayeeng nikanzek bei e na qou Yoan lukanzek. Moux moxo la qateiv Yoan kwa eivek xeitueing,
de qou e lukanzek lek dipekta me loum. Moxo wong ela wou vexawo yon, me vex on wong ela wou ta.
Gyeik ingwei Yoan xe xel betiyeing ngo tine eno xel lam qou e neing me liw e la eivek leiveeng meyeing ti.
Yesu vet xomaxoneing 5,000
Woyom sinaleyeiw qekuma vivekwou Yesu me wo qayeeng wou e en lul dalus wei xel wong me teyoxe yo.

Woyom nambei xomaxoneing ngenong di lox me loum, om xel nind seivma wei xel embei gya eno ma, om moxo neil wou xel, “Xam lam is ay, xam venaxow ghe gwei beyeeng wei xel ma veil o me ghe na qou laweeng.”
Om xel venaxow la ba nei eivek bot, me la ingwei xel ma veil o.
Ekom xel ngenong yeimend wou xel di la yo om xel veimyend lek vaxend nanghei beyeeng tambak nei me la inyon natax en xel.
Gyeik Yesu la yasewis eno yei xel qendu ngandoung on, om lalei pyaxow en xel, en xel on xok ambei sipsip wei gyovaxa ma veil o. Om moxo teyoxe xel en lulul ngenong.
Gyeik ingwei sayeiv di teila eno e xe xel betiyeing lam wou e me neil, “Beyeeng tine xel ma veil, de inye sayeiv di teila.
Wong xomaxoneing on la en kandek xel na ingwei xuk lalei nei me ne na beyeeng wei toundei paviyeing on me na bou xend lul yaeing valu.”

Ekom moxo lewexe, “Xam venaxow ghe bong lul valu wou xel en xel gya.” Xel neil wou e, “Malew ngandoung ma en ingwei xey a bei bou belet lek wou xel qendu ngandoung tine en yaeing. Tyek inyon teyei lek ambei dentouk qes lim yal en tambiy ti xe malew wei xouveing en xuk o!”
Moxo teling, “Xam ghe di qou belet vamva? Xam la wei.” Gyeik xel la yeiwou eno xel neil, “Belet lim de woing yuw is.”
Woyom Yesu wong xel la neil wou xel bei, xel mendei qendu qendu lek lesilek wei neluy yon.
Om xel dei qendu qendu teyei lek 100 me 50.

Moxo qou belet lim on me woing yuw on dom yeila tyoung gheyapu, de wong dange wou Anutu me dembu belet lim on. Me wong wou e xe xel betiyeing bei xel bong wou xomaxoneing me moxo vena dembu woing yuw on is ambei nyon wou xel dalus.
De xel on dalus ya me enden xel,
de xel betiyeing qekuwou belet me woing myapapu wei yo eivek pasik xoumeeng yuw.
Xomaxoneing wei ya yaeing on, eno moux teyei lek 5,000.
Yesu la lek memiing mapu
Lutika eno Yesu tendu e xe xel betiyeing on la eivek bot me wong xel la tax en e me la lounyeing loxalu wei beyeeng Betsaida nei, dekalekom wong xel bembeeng on la.
Ka e wong xel xomaxoneing on la woy, moxo lek me la lukendu nenyawes on bei na zeimema.
Gyeik ingwei di bouk eivek eno bot la tyip lounyeing masenghoing, dom e venaxow tateis toundei lek tembuing.
Moxo yeila xel betiyeing di wo pok lek sepaeing bot, en nambei laweeng ngandoung vei xel. Embim boyaing eno Yesu di la mapu lek lounyeing wou xel mend bei xel teyei bei gyei e,
ekom gyeik xel yei e di la lek lounyeing eno xel embeik nge inyon meyeing ti nu. Om xel nyayek niseikeing,
en nambei xel dalus yei e om xel nind yaleeng niseikeing. Lutika eno luk wou xel me neil, “Xam nale nimkanzek! Xam seng gwaleeng en inye ay yo.”
Om moxo lek la eivek bot is xel, de laweeng ma. Om moxoyeiw etek,
en xel se woulek qes wei Yesu wong gyeik dembu belet o. Ma. En inye xel laleind on wo nikanzekta.
Gyeik xel la nge loxalu, xel la yasewis lek tembuing Genesaret me tup bot nale inyon.
Ka xel lam myayaing veil bot, eno se denlek en xomaxoneing woulek Yesu.
Xel veimyend me la eivek beyeeng tambak on me qalei xel wei vanei yo lek ghus me qou xel me la ingwei xel ngo bei toundei nanghei yo.

Me beyeeng dalus wei moxo la eivek o, beyeeng me beyeeng nayak me beyeeng danghei danghei nei, xel mi toung xel wei vanei eno eivek beyeeng wei vateivek o. Xel mi tay wou bei e bong xel vanei daxlek e xe teimb ding myasepu. Om eti yeiw dalus wei mi axlek e yo eno mi wo nimzalek.
